## Professional Summary

Anurag Verma is a Full Stack Developer who transitioned from leading Data Science teams to building scalable web infrastructure. He specializes in Python (Django/FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (Next.js/React), and AI integration. With 3+ years of experience, he has led teams, built 300+ ML educational labs, and reduced operational costs by 35% through architectural improvements.
